name: labs/alba-synchrotron__sls-detector
title: SLS Mythen II detector (sls.client.Detector)
intro: SLS Mythen II detector (sls.client.Detector), adapted from alba-synchrotron/sls-detector. It reads `detector_type`, `run_status`, `settings`, `nb_modules` and 2 more; sets `energy_threshold`, `exposure_time`, `nb_frames`, `nb_cycles` and 2 more; runs `acquire`, `start_acquisition` and `stop_acquisition`. `acquire`: run one configured acquisition through Detector.acquire() and return the last frame. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
